advisories.title: Node.js October 21, 2026 security releases (highest severity: high)
advisories.message: Node.js 22.x, 24.x and 26.x before 22.23.4, 24.22.1 and 26.12.1 are affected by CVE-2026-105482, CVE-2026-105483, CVE-2026-106069, CVE-2026-111497 (Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write) and other issues fixed in the October 21, 2026 security releases.
